channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Keeps the red near 1.3350 as traders await BoE rate decision
item.description: The GBP/USD pair meets with fresh supply on Thursday and retreats further from the weekly high, around the 1.3385-1.3390 region, touched the previous day.

item.title: Euro trims daily losses as German preliminary GDP beats expectations
item.description: The Euro (EUR) nudges down against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, despite a mild uptick following stronger-than-expected German Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data.

item.title: Euro: Data-driven range trade into Q3 against US Dollar – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING writes that EUR/USD bounced modestly after the FOMC but was constrained by higher long-dated US yields and pressure on US growth stocks.

item.title: US GDP expected to grow at 2.1% in Q2, unshaken by Iran conflict
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) is set to publish its preliminary estimate of second-quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP) on Thursday, with analysts expecting the data to show annualised growth at a solid 2.1%, a modest cooling from the 2.1% expansion recorded in the previou

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD turns upside down amid soaring US Treasury Yields
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gives back its early gains and turns negative on Thursday. The white metal trades 0.7% lower at around $57.25 in the European trade after a positive start, which led to hitting an intraday high at $58.65.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI seen on hold as growth solid – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s analysts report that USD/INR has eased as India’s June industrial production surprised to the upside and inflation stayed within the Reserve Bank of India’s target band.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Extended pause with 2027 cuts – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Suan Teck Kin and Alvin Liew analyze the latest FOMC decision, noting the Fed Funds Target Rate remains at 3.50%-3.75% for a fifth straight meeting despite three dissenting votes favoring a hike.

item.title: Gold bears retain control as USD strengthens on Fed hike bets and Mideast crisis
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Thursday and seems vulnerable to following an intraday rejection near the $4,100 mark.

item.title: German flash Q2 GDP rises 0.2% QoQ, beats 0.1% estimates
item.description: German preliminary Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rises at a 0.2% pace, beating the estimates of 0.1%, according to the Federal Statistics Office of Germany. However, the GDP growth remains slower than the previous reading of 0.3%.

item.title: Swiss Franc retreats further despite bright KOF Leading Indicators data
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) Thursday despite the unexpected improvement of Swiss leading indicators.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Rebounds to near 101.00 as bullish bias prevails
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground after two days of losses and trading around 101.00 during the European hours on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound: BoE hike pricing supports Sterling against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG's Derek Halpenny notes that the British Pound (GBP) has been the strongest G10 currency after the US Dollar (USD) since the Middle East conflict began, with attention now on the Bank of England’s (BoE) July decision.

item.title: Australian Dollar stays on the defensive against a broadly firmer USD, ahead of US data
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's late rebound from the 0.6920 region, or an over two-week low, and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses through the early European session on Thursday.

item.title: Equities: Fed-driven yield spike pressures equities – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank notes that the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) on-hold decision and limited detail from Chair Warsh sparked a sharp steepening in the Treasury curve, pushing the 30-year yield to 5.20% and weighing on equities.

item.title: WTI Oil extends gains beyond $84.00 as US resumes strikes in Iran
item.description: Oil prices have risen about 7% over the last two days, pushing the price of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel to levels above $84.00 on Thursday, up from the $77.16 lows seen earlier in the week.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops amid surging US Treasury Yields
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) drops against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair edges down to near 95.60, with the Indian currency facing a tough fight against higher United States (US) Treasury Yields.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gains ground above 0.5800 as Fed hold mutes US Dollar
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.5810 during early European trading hours on Thursday, bolstered by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) rate hike bets.

item.title: US Dollar: Real yields drive correction risk – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that US real yields and the US Dollar (USD) fell after a confusing FOMC press conference, as markets sensed the Federal Reserve (Fed) may avoid further tightening.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA backs bullish bias
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades 0.1% higher at around 163.60 during the European trading session on Thursday. The pair rises as the US Dollar (USD) regains ground due to intensifying military aggression between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar stabilizes after post-Fed volatility, eyes on BoE and US GDP data
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Thursday, July 30:

item.title: Euro: Fed split supports EUR against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s FX Research team, including Charlie Lay and colleagues, notes that the Dollar Index fell and EUR/USD climbed after the Federal Reserve left rates unchanged but revealed a significant internal split.

item.title: Euro eases from four-week highs against the British Pound ahead of BoE’s decision
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has eased from fresh four-week highs at 0.8585 against the British Pound (GBP) on Thursday, but maintains its bullish trend intact with price action standing above previous highs.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Rebounds above 1.4050, constructive outlook prevails above 100-day SMA
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades in positive territory near 1.4050 during the early European session on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on hawkish signals from the US Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: A bullish comeback seems underway
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower to near 1.1455 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound declines as Fed hawkish rate holds boost US Dollar, BoE rate decision looms
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some sellers to near 1.3345 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the British Pound (GBP) amid hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) signals and escalating Middle East tensions.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds ground as Bank Indonesia intensifies efforts to stabilize markets
item.description: USD/IDR inches higher after opening at a bearish gap, remaining in negative territory and trading around 18,110 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound drifts lower vs Japanese Yen as bulls look to BoE and BoJ policy updates
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross struggles to capitalize on the previous day's solid bounce from the 217.15 area, or a two-week low, and meets with some supply during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens against Japanese Yen as chances of RBA rate hikes fall
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross declines to around 113.65 during the early European session on Thursday. The pair currently trades 0.65% lower on the week as the likelihood of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) raising interest rates has fallen.

item.title: Swiss Franc erodes part of Wednesday's gains to one-week top amid reviving USD demand
item.description: The USD/CHF pair regains positive traction on Thursday, rebounding from a one-week low and stalling its retracement slide from over a one-year high – levels just above the 0.8200 mark.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.
